title: Carmi
summary: Vine-dresser. (1.) The last named of the four sons of Reuben (Gen. 46:9).

inlines.v: Vine-dresser. (1.) The last named of the four sons of Reuben (Gen. 46:9).
(2.) A descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 4:1). He is elsewhere (2:18) called Caleb (q.v.).
(3.) The son of Zimri, and the father of Achan (Josh. 7:1), "the troubler of Israel."
